title: Lior and the Bakery
author: Silas Thornbury
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
